Senior Software Engineer, Fulfillment

Summary:
Senior Software Engineer optimizing Instacart’s grocery delivery fulfillment platform. Building scalable software, improving architectures, and leveraging AI tools for engineering excellence.
Senior Software Engineer optimizing Instacart’s grocery fulfillment platform
Role description:
• Design, build, and implement software solutions to optimize and scale the Instacart platform and related technologies, emphasizing fulfillment operations
• Develop highly scalable software using computer science and software engineering principles
• Establish protocols for rapidly rolling out upgrades and new features
• Analyze and optimize expensive SQL queries
• Execute ongoing testing and analysis of current systems
• Independently perform performance analysis, diagnosis, and troubleshooting
• Determine design solutions to problematic programming
• Analyze and refine complex architectures
• Propose new systems to improve delivery and operational excellence
• Leverage AI toolsets to accelerate development processes
• Establish new standards to improve engineering quality of partner-centric products
• Perform other duties as assigned
Role requirements:
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or foreign equivalent)
• 2 years of experience in the job offered or related
• 2 years of experience working with Java, Ruby, Python, or similar programming languages
• 2 years of experience working with MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, or similar data management systems
• 2 years of experience working with client/server architectures and application architectures
• 2 years of experience working with large codebases on cross-functional teams
• 2 years of experience employing advanced AI toolsets to accelerate development processes
• 2 years of experience deriving insights from complex data sets
• In lieu of a Master’s degree and 2 years of related experience, a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or foreign equivalent) and 5 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or related is accepted
Benefits:
• Flexibility to work from home, an office, or a favorite coffee shop
• Regular in-person events
• New hire equity grant
• Annual refresh grants
• Market-competitive compensation and benefits dependent on work location
Tech stack:
Java, MySQL, NoSQL, Postgres, Python, Ruby, SQL
